**Evidence summary (AI)**
After Nifty's longest losing streak in 25 years, analysts advise caution as the market faces pressure from elevated US Treasury yields, firm crude oil prices, and continued foreign outflows. The upcoming RBI policy, GST Council meeting, and earnings season will be key triggers for the market, with 22,200 remaining a crucial support level [1].

**Possible market relevance (AI analysis)**
The 8-week losing streak may lead to increased market volatility as investors focus on RBI policy, earnings, and global yields [2].
